'''2007 Texas State Championship Allen Gaible DS Cloud City: Upper Walkway''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Allen Gaible]] at [[2007 Texas State Championship]].

== Deck info ==

* '''Deck name:''' Cloud City Walkers
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS13]]
